integrity: The mathematical result concerns a new heterogeneous-radius exact profile and optimizing positive weights, not the previously known equiradial worst constant. Analytical all-parameter proof supplied; finite computations are corroboration only.
scientific_limitations: One added point; unit-equilateral original metric; real Banach targets; not multiple-point or quasi-Banach extension. Sharp equiradial global upper envelope was already established by Basso (2021); no independent mathematics audit or independent novelty certification.
title: Order-statistic law for universal one-point Lipschitz extensions of equilateral metrics
